risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (369.92), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring multinationals, with earnings event in 41 days adding execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Hull flip up, three white soldiers, and 15x volume spike confirm bullish structure with price above key moving averages, supported by extreme fear sentiment (15/100) presenting contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought confluence (RSI-9 at 80.5, Stoch at 92.45, Williams %R, UO), weak ADX trend strength (18.12), zero fundamental catalysts, elevated earnings risk in 41 days, and severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising dollar) create exhaustion setup with high pullback probability.
